testcase.name: opening the Seasonal tab before any region is chosen is a no-op
a seasonal pattern fetch failure is reported, not swallowed, without the provider's own message
opening the Seasonal tab after a search fetches and populates the distribution
nothing is fetched until the Seasonal tab is actually opened
changing the category invalidates the cached seasonal pattern and refetches on next open
revisiting the Seasonal tab without changing the search does not refetch
an IconicCategory filter and a SpecificTaxon filter both reach the seasonal fetch unchanged
